summary: The Data Production and Dissemination Officer role is highly exposed to automation, but the likely outcome is transformation rather than simple reduction. Routine editing, validation, standard product assembly, and common user support tasks will decline as automated validation, self-service dissemination, and AI-enabled support expand. At the same time, the role will grow in importance for exception analysis, multi-source quality assessment, metadata-aware dissemination, privacy-conscious support, and interpretation of more complex outputs. Future success will depend on upskilling in automated validation, metadata, digital platforms, multi-source data quality, and digitally enabled user support.
